rationale: Increment 2 reuses the increment-1 ranking core as a payload producer: the candidate collection and buildSuggestions logic in src/tools/suggest-next-task.ts must be exported/refactored for event-driven reuse, while src/tools/suggest-next-task-ranking.ts holds the named-decision constants (overdue x30, 48h +20, priority 25/20/15/5, recency +2) that must re-render identically and is imported by the new payload path. The payload threads into the execute results of src/tools/create-task.ts and src/tools/update-task.ts via the increment-1 { suggestions, considered } vocabulary, with update_task also being the completion event (status change fires completionHook at src/tools/update-task.ts:130; the completed task is excluded from candidates in the payload builder). src/tools/core-tools.ts wires the factories and must thread the payload dependencies (provider/userId/storageContextId already flow through makeCoreTools). src/completion/verified-completion.ts is a separate top-level module (src/completion/) whose verifier reads tool results from the turn, so the completion-carried payload must survive/degrade there — hence cross_module true. Suppression (no payload while a confirmation flow is pending) lands as structured-status short-circuit inside the create/update factories (confirmation_required/identity_required/permission_denied results skip payload attachment), not in a new module; the size-cap constant joins the ranking constants block. No DB migration (increment 1 was explicitly zero-persistence and increment 2 adds result payloads only), no provider contract change (reuses listTasks/listProjects/formatDueDateOutput; the TaskListItem.createdAt passthrough already shipped), no credentials. Novelty is existing-modules: every touched file lives in the existing src/tools/ tool family or the existing src/completion/ module; the payload producer is an export from the existing suggest-next-task module, not a new subsystem. Test files follow the increment-1 TDD pattern (tests/tools/suggest-next-task.test.ts, create/update-task tests, tests/completion/verified-completion.test.ts); the ranking test pins the constants that must not drift.
